checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Starts with storefront with striped awning and tables
must.why: The 1 s frame shows the storefront with the awning and tables intact.

must.item: Latte and pastry counter recognisable in later shots
must.why: The latte with the leaf is clear. The croissant counter is recognisable, though the scene was expanded with invented details.

must.item: Opening text 'Maple Street Café' and closing text 'Your morning starts here'
must.why: No text appears in any sampled frame.

must.item: Gentle visible movement, framed without stretching
must.why: The frames show camera movement. The photos were extended to 16:9 rather than stretched. The pastry shot adds a lot of new content.

must.item: Vertical, about 9 s, soft upbeat music with no speech
must.why: The video is 16:9 widescreen, not vertical. The length is 10.1 s, which is close to 9 s. The music mood cannot be judged.

exact_text.read_as: no opening text visible in the frame at 1 s
no closing text visible in the frame at 9.6 s

faults.what: The video is horizontal 16:9, but a vertical reel was needed.
The required opening and closing text overlays are missing.
The pastry shot was heavily re-imagined. The camera view changed, and new people, plates and menu cards were added. It no longer matches the original photo.
The latte shot gained a green chair and a person's legs at the sides. The scene was extended with invented content.
The croissants and the menu text show some AI softness and a slight warp.

summary: The clip is a smooth, recognisable 10 s widescreen tour of the three photos, but it is not vertical and has none of the required title or closing text.
